card.label: S. 2296
card.summary: S. 2296, the National Defense Authorization Act for Fiscal Year 2026, sets policies, authorities, and funding levels for Department of Defense programs, military construction, and Department of Energy national security programs. It also incorporates numerous specific acts concerning intelligence activities, coast guard operations, maritime systems, housing reforms, and state department authorizations.
card.title: National Defense Authorization Act for Fiscal Year 2026

card.summary: The ROAD to Housing Act of 2025 aims to increase the supply and affordability of housing in the United States by reforming housing counseling and financial literacy programs, streamlining environmental and regulatory reviews for housing developments, creating grant and pilot programs for home repairs and building conversions, reforming disaster recovery assistance, and making changes to rural housing, veteran housing, and appraisal standards.
card.title: ROAD to Housing Act of 2025
